name: Detalle Capilar
description: Analiza la consistencia del detalle capilar en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Hair Detail Analysis — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes hair rendering detail for deepfake detection:

1. **Cabello Región Segmentation**: Hair regions are segmented per frame using semantic segmentation. The hair mass, hairline contour, and individual strand visibility are analyzed. Hair is one of the most challenging elements for AI generators due to its semi-transparent, fine-structured nature.

2. **Strand - Level Análisis**: In sufficient resolution, individual hair strands or strand groups should be visible. The method detects linear high-frequency features consistent with hair strands using oriented filters. AI-generated hair often appears as a smooth texture blob lacking individual strand detail, or shows repeating strand patterns (texture repetition).

3. **Hairline Transition Análisis**: The hairline — where hair meets forehead skin — is a critical forensic region. Natural hairlines show gradual transition with individual hairs and baby hairs. Deepfake hairlines may be unnaturally sharp, irregular, or show blending artifacts where the generated face meets the original hair.

4. **Cabello - Luz Interaction**: Real hair shows complex light interaction: specular highlights following hair curvature (Marschner model), translucency at thin sections, and anisotropic reflectance. The method evaluates hair rendering against physical reflectance models. AI generators often produce over-simplified hair-light interaction.

5. **Temporal Cabello Estabilidad**: Hair maintains its large-scale structure across frames, with strand-level motion following physics (inertia, gravity, coherent flow). The method tracks hair consistency — deepfake generators may produce temporally unstable hair rendering with flickering texture, shifting hairline, or physically impossible hair motion.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante hair detail analysis analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
